igi-timis-page.note: Page dated 14 May 2024. It lists the Timiș office as Str. Andrei Mocioni nr. 8-10, Timișoara, phone 0256.402430.

igi-contact.title: IGI contact page (territorial offices)
igi-contact.note: Linked from the IGI website. Not opened; use it to check current contact details and opening hours.

igi-forms.title: IGI forms
igi-forms.note: Linked from the IGI website. Not opened.

igi-faq.title: IGI frequently asked questions
igi-faq.note: Linked from the IGI website. Not opened.

igi-oug194.title: Emergency Ordinance 194/2002 on the regime of foreigners (PDF on igi.mai.gov.ro)
igi-oug194.note: The legal basis for foreigners' stay. Linked from IGI. Not read in full; the law may have been amended.

igi-portal.title: IGI online portal
igi-portal.note: Mentioned by a university page as an online way to apply. Not opened.

uav-permit.title: Aurel Vlaicu University of Arad: Obtaining the Student Residence Permit
uav-permit.note: A university guide (page marked 2025), not IGI itself. Requirements and fees may have changed.

umf-cluj-stay.title: UMF Cluj-Napoca: Legal stay of foreign citizens in Romania
umf-cluj-stay.note: A university guide (page last modified May 2023), not IGI itself.

upt-international.title: Politehnica University Timișoara: International Students Office

upt-edu.title: Politehnica University Timișoara: International Students (incl. International Student Guide)
upt-edu.note: Links to an International Student Guide PDF for 2026-2027. The PDF was not read.

primariatm-evidenta.title: Timișoara City Hall: report of the population records directorate (PDF)
primariatm-evidenta.note: Undated activity report. Lists the address, services (ID cards, residence registration) and a 5 working-day processing time for residence registration.

hub-cei.title: HUB-MAI: appointments for the electronic ID card
hub-cei.note: Named in the City Hall report as the only way to book electronic ID card appointments. Not opened.

anaf-home.title: ANAF: National Agency for Fiscal Administration

anaf-timis-contact.title: ANAF: contact page of the Timiș county tax administration (PDF)
anaf-timis-contact.note: Undated. Lists address, phone and opening hours.

cnas-home.title: CNAS: National Health Insurance House
cnas-home.note: Main website. Specific rules for foreign students were not read.

youreurope-registration.title: Your Europe: registering residence of EU citizens' family members after 3 months
youreurope-registration.note: Describes the EU-wide registration after 3 months for family members. It does not cover Romanian rules for students.

logs-home.title: Asociația LOGS – Grup de Inițiative Sociale (Casa LOGS Timișoara)
logs-home.note: Official NGO website listing Casa LOGS counseling center in Timișoara (Str. Țebea nr. 12), phone, and email.

uvt-home.title: West University of Timișoara (UVT): Department of International Relations
uvt-home.note: Official university website listing the main campus address at Bd. Vasile Pârvan nr. 4, 300223 Timișoara.

umft-home.title: Victor Babeș University of Medicine and Pharmacy Timișoara (UMFT)
umft-home.note: Official university website listing the main address at Piața Eftimie Murgu nr. 2, 300041 Timișoara.

igi-residence-permit.title: IGI: Residence permit (how and when to apply)
igi-residence-permit.note: Official IGI page. Says documents must be submitted in person at least 30 days before the right to stay granted by the visa expires, and that documents can also be uploaded through the online service portaligi.mai.gov.ro. Read through a search excerpt; the full page could not be opened while preparing this data.

igi-single-permit.title: IGI: Single permit / EU Blue Card
igi-single-permit.note: Official IGI page. After entering Romania, workers must obtain a single permit (or EU Blue Card) from the IGI unit of the county where they live. Read through a search excerpt.

igi-employment.title: IGI: Employment and posting
igi-employment.note: Official IGI page, written before the 2026 reform: the employer obtains the work authorisation and the worker can be employed by a single employer. Read through a search excerpt.

workinromania.title: WorkinRomania.gov.ro (single online application for hiring non-EU workers)
workinromania.note: Platform introduced by Emergency Ordinance 32/2026. Several law and advisory firms report that from 8 August 2026 employers file one application here and the separate work permit (aviz de muncă) was abolished. The platform itself could not be opened while preparing this data.

igi-asylum-general.title: IGI: Asylum and integration, general description
igi-asylum-general.note: Official IGI page. Asylum requests are received, registered and processed at regional centres for accommodation and procedures for asylum seekers, including one in Timișoara. Read through a search excerpt.

igi-protection-docs.title: IGI: Identity and travel documents (asylum seekers and people with protection)
igi-protection-docs.note: Official IGI page. The temporary identity document of an asylum seeker is extended during the procedure; there are no fees for issuing the residence permit to people granted protection. Read through search excerpts.

igi-integration.title: IGI: Integration programme for people granted protection

aida-ro-registration.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, registration of the asylum application
aida-ro-registration.note: Independent legal report. IGI registers a request within 3 working days if made directly to IGI, and within 6 days if made to other authorities such as the Border Police.

aida-ro-overview.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, short overview of the asylum procedure
aida-ro-overview.note: Applicants are photographed, fingerprinted and receive a temporary identity document that includes a personal numeric code.

aida-ro-regular.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, regular procedure
aida-ro-regular.note: Reports an average of about 35.6 days from application to first-instance decision in 2025.

unhcr-ro-asylum.title: UNHCR Romania: How to apply for asylum
unhcr-ro-asylum.note: UN Refugee Agency help site. Describes the preliminary interview and the longer main interview (2-3 hours).

unhcr-ro-legal.title: UNHCR Romania: Reliable information and legal counselling
unhcr-ro-legal.note: Lists free legal counselling partners that help in Romanian, Ukrainian, Russian and English.

unhcr-ro-cash.title: UNHCR Romania: Cash assistance (asylum seekers)
unhcr-ro-cash.note: Says that after a final rejection, without another right to stay, a person must leave Romania within 15 days.

unhcr-ro-tp.title: UNHCR Romania: Temporary protection (people from Ukraine)
unhcr-ro-tp.note: Registration at any IGI immigration office; gives a residence permit, access to work, healthcare and education for children.

unhcr-ro-entry.title: UNHCR Romania: Entry requirements for people from Ukraine
unhcr-ro-entry.note: Ukrainian citizens with a biometric passport may stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period without registering for temporary protection.

unhcr-ro-returns.title: UNHCR Romania: Questions and answers on returns to Ukraine

eu-tp-extension.title: Council of the EU: How the EU helps refugees from Ukraine (temporary protection until 4 March 2028)
eu-tp-extension.note: Official EU page: temporary protection was last extended until 4 March 2028 (Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1912).

reges-portal.title: Labour Inspection: REGES, the national register of employees
reges-portal.note: Official portal where employers register employment contracts (it replaced the older Revisal register). Read through a search excerpt.

e-justice-ro-trafficking.title: European e-Justice portal: Romania, victims’ rights and support (anti-trafficking helpline)
e-justice-ro-trafficking.note: Lists the national anti-trafficking helpline 0800 800 678 (toll-free, available around the clock) and +40 21 313 3100 from abroad.

aida-ro-labour-market.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, access to the labour market
aida-ro-labour-market.note: Asylum applicants can work after 3 months from lodging the application if there is no decision, on the same conditions as Romanian citizens.

aida-ro-reception-health.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, health care for asylum applicants
aida-ro-reception-health.note: Asylum applicants receive free medical care through IGI’s medical network and do not pay the health insurance contribution for it.

aida-ro-protection-content.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, content of international protection
aida-ro-protection-content.note: The integration programme runs for 12 months from the date of the signed protocol.

aida-ro-social-welfare.title: Asylum Information Database (ECRE): Romania, social welfare for people with protection
aida-ro-social-welfare.note: People with protection who lack means can ask for a monthly non-reimbursable aid for up to 12 months.

unhcr-ro-rights-duties.title: UNHCR Romania: Rights and duties of asylum seekers

unhcr-ro-shelter.title: UNHCR Romania: Shelter and accommodation
unhcr-ro-shelter.note: Asylum seekers without enough resources can be accommodated in a Regional Reception Centre.

unhcr-ro-health-ua.title: UNHCR Romania: Health care for people with temporary protection
unhcr-ro-health-ua.note: People with temporary protection are entitled to the listed health services, which are free of charge and have no time limit.

unhcr-ro-integration.title: UNHCR Romania: Integration services
unhcr-ro-integration.note: The Romanian National Council for Refugees (CNRR), UNHCR’s main partner, offers services to people with refugee status or subsidiary protection.

unhcr-ro-housing-ua.title: UNHCR Romania: Housing and accommodation for people from Ukraine
unhcr-ro-housing-ua.note: UNHCR does not directly offer accommodation or cash assistance; it works with local authorities and partners.

your-europe-bank.title: Your Europe: Opening a basic bank account within the EU
your-europe-bank.note: People legally resident in an EU country are entitled to open a basic payment account.
